parameters.content:
## 1. Receive command
Command **/anhbia <id> [request]**. Only for posts pending approval / scheduled that have an image.

## 2. AI re-lays the image as 16:9 landscape
The approved square image goes to the cheap model to redraw a landscape layout (text left, picture right, no logo/hotline) → AI checks the text → redraw with the strong model on failure → code overlays the logo + hotline bar.

## 3. Save & preview
Upload the image unpublished to the Fanpage to get a link → write column **Ảnh bìa OA** in the Sheet → send it to the Zalo group for review. Cross-posting uses it as the OA cover.
The old cover is saved to **edit history** (type: cover) → /lichsu <id> bia, /hoantac <id> bia [version].
